sources.label: TCEQ permit letter, Nov. 16
sources.evidence_excerpt: The registration letter authorizes emissions associated with 43 natural gas-powered generators at the Boca Chica Facility under standard permit 185303, subject to the registered conditions.

sources.label: TCEQ technical review
sources.evidence_excerpt: The review lists 1,456.22 MW and records the company's confirmation that it will obtain a Title V operating permit.

sources.label: Cameron County Commissioners Court agenda, Nov. 17
sources.evidence_excerpt: Agenda item 4H concerns authorization to post notice of intent to consider a Chapter 312 tax abatement.

sources.label: KRGV, Nov. 17
sources.evidence_excerpt: Only two members voted to move the request ahead. The application cited an estimated $24 billion investment and 500 jobs.

sources.label: San Antonio Express-News, Nov. 20
claims: Project connection to the 43-generator air permit
sources.evidence_excerpt: Reporting links the 43-generator authorization to the data-center project and describes the defeated procedural motion and proposed annual payments.

sources.label: KRGV, Nov. 19
sources.evidence_excerpt: SpaceX said the proposed payments in lieu of taxes would give the county more predictable revenue as equipment depreciated.

sources.label: City of Starbase public notices
sources.evidence_excerpt: The city lists a December 9 public hearing on tax abatement and economic development agreements.

sources.label: Reuters, Nov. 9
sources.evidence_excerpt: Reuters independently reports the city hearing on a proposed tax abatement and economic development agreement for the roughly $24 billion project.
